test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 13th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate SYNONYM of the given word.

Repel
solution:
The correct answer is "**Resist**".

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• A ***Synonym*** is any pair of words or phrases that have a ***common vocabulary*** and have the same meaning in some or all senses.
 
• ***Repel*** means to prevent something from approaching you or attacking you whereas ***Resist*** means to stop oneself from getting or engaging in something that one desires.
 
• Therefore, Resist is an appropriate synonym for Repel.
 
• ***Example***: *The invitation was difficult to resist.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• ***Retains*** means to hold onto it or keep it.
 
• ***Remit*** means to send back.
 
• ***Regret*** means to feel guilty about something you did or did not do.
